name: Integral Capital Group
decision_note: Budapest/Belgrade/London-based mid-market private equity and growth capital firm (80% of MindentMent, Jan 2026); real and active but not VC and without a Czech office, so outside the cz-vc pilot.

evidence.quote: Integral Capital Group is an independently owned private equity and growth capital investment firm focused on the evolving Europe region operating out of hubs in London, Budapest, and Belgrade.
is pleased to announce that it has completed the acquisition of an 80% stake in MindentMent (“MDM”), Hungary’s largest private dental services provider.

analyst_notes: Quick S1 dossier. Own site: mid-market private equity platform for Central and South-Eastern Europe and the Adria region; LPs include EIF, EBRD and IFC. Other dated activity on the site: majority stake in Embryos (2025-02-03), agreed sale of Graphwise (2026-08-19). Ticket and fund size not found on the pages read; the CVCA profile (class D, 2020) says EUR 200m under management and EUR 5-15m tickets, with one Czech portfolio company (Borcad). Hungarian/UK entities not looked up.
